topology_recipe.closed_profile_mesh: For each ordered same-sided ring list, create quads (ring i vertex j, j+1, ring i+1 j+1, ring i+1 j), triangulate every quad as [a,b,d] and [b,c,d], then cap first and last ring with a centroid fan. Compute outward normals after winding verification. No open leaf planes, Boolean, voxel remesh, or geometry merge.
topology_recipe.closed_wedge: For each 8-vertex plate/foot/toe record, use front quad [0,1,2,3], rear quad [4,7,6,5], and side quads [0,4,5,1], [1,5,6,2], [2,6,7,3], [3,7,4,0]; triangulate each quad consistently outward.
topology_recipe.physical_joins: Wing host_root_a and host_root_b are buried full ring faces in torso. Each plate root face is buried in the primary wing between host_root_b and shoulder_fold. Each leg host_root ring is buried in torso. Each foot top quad overlaps the leg foot_root volume; each toe root face overlaps its foot volume. Join checks must reject separated shells.
